THREE PROBE DEFECTS CAUGHT BY CROSS-CHECKING AGAINST LEAVES ALREADY READ BY HAND: (1) a histogram cannot tell a clipped body from a full-width note BLOCK - it proposed importing all 88 of ch23 p89's note tokens into scripture, and only line-membership refuses that; (2) taking the FIRST dip-then-spike caught a ripple in the taper of body line-ends (p132 at 0.73) instead of the 22-token column at 0.76 - a column is the TALLEST thing on its side of a leaf; (3) corroboration measured at a leaf's CURRENT bound is a fact about the campaign's history, not the page - p90/p92 scored 0/0 because they were fixed yesterday, and the leaves that motivated the probe read as uncorroborated. Cutting scripture is not symmetric with keeping a gloss, so an uncorroborated right bound moves only on an unmistakable spike: p35 (a real citation column) and p79 (body) BOTH spike exactly 12, so 12 discriminates nothing - the bar sits above both and p35 is carried as a hand-verified entry with its reason. p105 and p159 rejected by eye. p92's right bound confirms the prediction that yesterday's left-only fix was half a fix.
